rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: **Summary:** read for gist → underline key ideas → draft (author's main idea first, then 2–4 key supports) → cut modifiers/examples to fit the word limit → verify meaning is unchanged and nothing is copied.  ·  **Summary grammar:** four paraphrase moves — synonym swap (threat→danger), word-class change (pollute→pollution), voice change (active↔passive), sentence merge; report verbs frame it ('the passage argues…'). Never add your own opinion.

rows.label: Hints
rows.text: recall card: definition → formula → limit → one error to avoid.  ·  **Note-making:** TITLE in caps → numbered sub-headings (1, 2, 3 — noun phrases, one per paragraph) → compact key-phrase points (a, b, c) → abbreviations (&, →, e.g.) with an 'Abbreviations used' note.

rows.label: MCQ drill
rows.text: A common examiner point on "Summary and Note-making" is that a statement is only valid when its condition of applicability is met. Is that TRUE or FALSE? → True

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Note grammar:** nominalise verbs for headings ('agricultural expansion'); drop articles/auxiliaries in points; every point under 7 words.  ·  **Full guide:** Full model answers, starting-line banks and exam tips: [/knowledge/writing](/knowledge/writing).
